content: The incident write‑up (INC‑0054) shows that the outage on 19 June 2025 was not caused by a software or hardware fault. The Redis Sentinel cluster was deliberately instructed to perform a failover – the master role (`cache`) was moved from redis‑cache‑01 to redis‑cache‑02 via a manual `SENTINEL FAILOVER <master name>` command. That intentional failover caused the two cache nodes to go offline and broke the catalog‑API.
